description: Fetch a committee by committee_id (GET /v1/committees/{committee_id}), optionally merging in members (its roster, with roles) and hearings (its scheduled meetings). Find a committee_id with list_committees.

max_items.description: Cap on items per included list (default 50).

name: get_committee
title: Get one committee
